request.text: Check whether it will rain in Hangzhou tomorrow afternoon. Only if the forecast says rain, set a reminder for 8:40 tonight that says, ‘Do my indoor breathing routine instead of the park walk.’ Do not remind me if rain isn't forecast.

responsibilities.outcome: Determine whether rain is forecast in Hangzhou tomorrow afternoon.
Create an 8:40 tonight reminder to do the indoor breathing routine instead of the park walk only when the requested forecast reports rain.

bindings.reminder_content: Do my indoor breathing routine instead of the park walk.

semantic_facts: The plan must obtain Hangzhou's tomorrow-afternoon forecast before deciding whether the reminder condition is satisfied.
The 8:40-tonight reminder with the supplied indoor-routine text is authorized only if trusted forecast evidence reports rain; a non-rain result must not create it.
The forecast's location, date, and day part must remain separate from the reminder's due time and content.
forbidden_claims: The planner creates an unconditional reminder or treats the not-yet-observed forecast as evidence of rain.
The planner swaps tomorrow afternoon with tonight, changes Hangzhou, alters the reminder text or time, or claims either operation completed without trusted evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A conditional state change is flattened into an unconditional reminder before the evidence-producing lookup finishes.
Parameters from the weather query and reminder leak across sibling Responsibilities, corrupting their separate dates, times, or content.
